proofs.text: Start the server in an empty directory and send `sync_status` with `project_root` naming a real workspace; verify the answer carries the feature name `login` from that workspace

rule_text: A call may name its own workspace with `project_root`, which is resolved and used for that call alone; without it the tool uses the root the server resolved at startup

tests.name: test_project_root_can_be_named_per_call
